art_direction: 少量不规则陶片拼出柠檬与短枝，浅灰勾缝和湖绿背景衬托柠黄色主体。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Assemble a lemon and one short leafy branch from a small number of irregular glazed ceramic pieces. Use large yellow fragments for the fruit, three green pieces for the leaves, and a thin dark curved piece for the stem. Pale gray grout should separate the shapes without making a dense grid. Set the mosaic on a solid muted lagoon background, centered as a compact still-life emblem. Keep the lemon contour readable even though its interior is faceted. Show slight differences in glaze reflection and tile height, with no photorealistic environment beyond the mosaic surface. No border or inscription. Limit the fragment count so the composition remains simple at avatar size.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
